prompt:
Our procurement team at ElectroSource Ltd. needs to automate navigation for a sourcing session on Alibaba. I've prepared a sourcing brief at `procurement/sourcing_requests/sourcing_brief.json` that lists all the pages we need to visit: category searches (some with special view settings), specific product pages, supplier company profiles, a supplier-specific product search, and a few special Alibaba sections including their AI Mode, Top Ranking page, and the RFQ submission page.

Please process this brief and produce a single file named `alibaba_url_manifest.json` containing all the correctly built navigation URLs for each task entry. Make sure the product page URLs properly handle the raw product titles (which have messy punctuation and special characters) and that all search queries use the right encoding. Each URL entry should be keyed or labeled by its task_id.
